title: Agent Admission Revoke — payload
description: A supervisor revokes an admitted agent's relationship credential; the gate authority records it and mirrors a revocation mark to every anchored registry.

credentialId.description: The credential being revoked — its digest or ceremony identifier.

agent.description: VID of the agent whose standing ends.

reason.description: Recorded, durable free text. Never mirrored to anchors.

mirroredAnchors.description: Anchors the revocation mark has converged to. MAY be shorter than the credential's anchor set when a mirror failed (`mirrorFailed`, retryable).
